 ▝▝   ▝▝   C:\work\project

⚠ Allow rule "Edit(*)" lets Edit run without asking only in the working directories. "Edit" alone allows every path. Older versions of Claude Code treat
  "Edit(*)" as "Edit", and this version will too if Anthropic turns this change off.
⚠ Allow rule "Write(*)" lets Write run without asking only in the working directories. "Write" alone allows every path. Older versions of Claude Code treat
  "Write(*)" as "Write", and this version will too if Anthropic turns this change off.
⚠ Allow rule "Read(*)" adds nothing to Read's default, which already runs without asking in the working directories. "Read" alone allows every path. Older
  versions of Claude Code treat "Read(*)" as "Read", and this version will too if Anthropic turns this change off.
